D: Mike and Sulley start out as rivals at university and end up in the Scare Games with a frat of misfits.
P: Serve the snacks when the Oozma Kappas move into the Scare Games.
S: Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky honey barbecue glaze, with ranch dip.
the Oozma Kappa frat house in Squishy's mum's home
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter and purple and green sprinkles, a pinch of salt, served in big bowls.
Crisp oven fries under melted cheese sauce, spring onion and a few pickled jalapeños. Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C until crisp.
M: the dining hall at Monsters University
Pizza dough topped with tomato, mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms, baked at 250C for 10 minutes, cut into squares.
Spaghetti with beef meatballs simmered in tomato sauce, with garlic bread, a big pot for the study group.
W: Sulley's blue fur with purple spots
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with shaggy blue buttercream and purple sprinkles.
K: Mike Wazowski, one big green eye
Cloudy apple juice with soda water, lime and mint, tinted green with an apple round floating on top.

s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 125ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey and toss the wings through. Mix sour cream with mayonnaise and chives for a ranch dip and serve alongside.

Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C until crisp. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 300ml milk until thick and stir in 150g grated cheddar. Pour over the chips and top with sliced spring onion and pickled jalapeños.

m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into meatballs and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and simmer 40 minutes. Split a baguette, spread with garlic butter and bake until crisp. Toss the sauce through 500g spaghetti with parmesan and serve the lot.

w.note: Sulley's blue fur with purple spots
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat butter, icing sugar and blue colouring and pipe with a grass tip for shaggy fur. Add purple sprinkles.

d.note: Mike Wazowski, one big green eye
d.how: Pour 750ml cloudy apple juice and 400ml soda water into a jug with the juice of 1 lime and a handful of mint. Stir in a few drops of green food colouring and pour over ice, with a thin round of green apple floating on top.
